en.headline: Mainland hotpot ingredients chain Guoquan opens first Hong Kong store in Wan Chai
en.dek: The Hennessy Road outlet is described by the company as a ‘test bed’ for overseas expansion, offering community-kitchen style products adapted for local tastes.
body: Mainland home-dining retailer Guoquan Shihui opened its first Hong Kong store on Tuesday on Hennessy Road in Wan Chai, marking the start of its overseas expansion.

The company, which operates more than 12,000 outlets on the Mainland and is listed in Hong Kong, said the store would serve as a test bed for product development, supply-chain arrangements and local service standards. Its overseas general manager described Hong Kong as both a capital-market window and a bridge to international markets.

The outlet continues the group’s ‘community central kitchen’ concept, stocking hotpot and barbecue ingredients alongside breakfast items, ready-to-eat meals and products tailored to local preferences such as Hong Kong-style satay beef sauce and pineapple tom yum bases. The company said the timing coincided with the recent HKTDC Food Expo.

zh.headline: 內地火鍋食材店鍋圈食匯灣仔開首店
zh.dek: 軒尼詩道門店被集團定位為海外布局「試驗田」，延續社區央廚模式並加入本地化產品。
body: 內地居家餐飲零售商鍋圈食匯周二於灣仔軒尼詩道開設香港首店，正式展開海外擴張。
集團在內地擁有逾12,000家門店，並於香港上市。海外業務負責人表示，香港既是資本市場窗口，亦是連接國際的橋樑，今次開店旨在鍛鍊跨區域產品研發、供應鏈及本地服務能力，將香港視為拓展海外的「試驗田」。
門店延續「社區央廚」概念，除火鍋及燒烤食材外，亦提供早餐、即食餐及配合本地口味的產品，例如港式沙嗲牛肉醬及菠蘿冬陰功底料。集團指開業時間配合近日貿發局美食博覽。
